features.scope: Open a named hosted file with account credentials; basic native connection path exists. A host's refusal after too many failed logins (error 214) is reported as such.

features.scope: Validation, generated values and held-import preflight were corrected in #67/#73; supported paths have regression controls. The supported exact-match text lookup form copies a stored text field from the first related record through one unsorted relationship of `=` predicates on stored text fields when a write changes the match field; the looked-up value appears when the record is written, not when Tab leaves the match field.
features.remaining: Compare native fill-only, lookup, unique/list validation and refusal behavior. Other lookup forms (next lower or higher value, constants, several or sorted relationships, other field types), serial numbers and entry from the last visited record still make a table read-only; native selection among several matches, lookups fired by scripts and imports, and FileMaker Server's runtime are unmeasured (issue 186).

features.scope: Client and provider implement multi-request found-set operations and field matching.
features.remaining: Differential native result IDs for mixed requests and operators. A criterion over 10,000 characters is unreadable (error 3 in a script), OpenMaker's limit; FileMaker's is unmeasured.

features.scope: Script sorts, unsort and window found-set isolation are wired and tested.
features.remaining: Native collation, mixed types, summary sorting and tie order.

features.scope: Merged #65/#73/#74 add bounded fallbacks and response-completion checks. Supported forms/languages and resource limits are narrower than general native indexing. The provider's field-value retrieval for value-list sorting and Insert from Index returns the whole list or error 3, within its 100,000-value and 64 MiB bounds, using the host's list, its index or a scan (docs/value-lists-missing-index.md).
features.remaining: Cover unsupported collations/types separately; retain literal warm-index differential fixtures. Values that must be keyed in a tailored index language, or as negative, fractional or localized numbers, are refused (issues 195, 196); static analysis shows FileMaker Server sends entries past 1,000 bytes in pieces, which the desktop rejects (issue 464); a captured large FileMaker Server reply and native whole-list acceptance remain unverified (issue 366). HostFile::value_list_entries, which checkbox and radio sets, pop-up menus and drop-down lists use (C35), is a separate path from this one. Drop-down calendars do not open in Browse yet (issue 178).

features.scope: Own-table single-repetition checkbox/radio sets support mouse/keyboard edits, primary-value storage behind secondary labels, per-object triggers and save/readback. Own-table pop-up menus showing one repetition, with Edit field entry, open in Browse on a custom list or a list of a field's values in this file: the closed control shows the stored value's label, and a chosen item goes through the shared choice operation into the record's draft, then the typed-edit path (OnObjectModify, validation, lock, commit). A drop-down list showing its arrow stays the field's edit box and opens the same items from the arrow; a chosen item takes the same path, and Escape closes the list and keeps the draft.
features.remaining: Portal/related/repeated sets, menus and lists, Other/Edit items, drop-down calendars, drop-down lists without their arrow, auto-complete, the keyboard in a menu or list beyond Escape, also-display labels and calculated entry remain limited; text fields do not yet honor the option-set entry guard. Another file's or a calculated list, and more than 100,000 items, are refused. The menu's and list's position, width and timing, how a second-field list labels its items, and the order of triggers on a choice are not compared with FileMaker Pro (issue 178).

features.scope: Shared physical pages include title/grand parts, sorted nested subsummary groups and supported slide-up/part shrinking. Ordinary buttons without an icon and plain groups, nested groups included, print in Preview, PDF and Print from the one report scene; their scripts are not run (docs/portable-pdf.md, Buttons and groups). Frames whose four corners share an absolute radius print rounded, with a border that is the same on every side (docs/portable-pdf.md, Rounded frames).
features.remaining: No slide-left, hide-when-printing, bodyless reports, related break fields or part page breaks; native output equivalence unmeasured. Button icons, rounded frames with differing corners, a relative or automatic radius, a border that differs by side or is as wide as the frame, rounded pictures and parts, rotation, hide and conditional calculations, popover buttons, button bars, portals, tab and slide panels and other containers still refuse the report with error 3; FileMaker's printing of buttons, groups and rounded frames is inferred, not compared (issue 263).

features.feature: Save Records as PDF / PDF script workflows
features.scope: Searchable vector PDF shares report geometry with Preview/Print, including static PNG/JPEG, grouped summaries and supported sliding. Scripts, File > Save/Send Records As > PDF and the Share menu's and Preview toolbar's Save as PDF run the same step, with its dialog for the records being browsed or the current record. Ordinary buttons without an icon, plain groups and rounded frames print as in Preview (C41).
features.remaining: Advanced PDF options, Save Records as PDF in server scripts (issue 261) and native FileMaker acceptance remain limited. Layouts with the objects C41 lists as refused (other containers, button icons, the rounded frames it names) refuse the PDF too (issue 263).

features.scope: File-menu export exposes supported formats and the owning found set, using the existing script export engine. File > Save/Send Records As > Excel and the toolbars' Save as Excel run Save Records as Excel through the shared command, for the records being browsed or the current record. A script step stored with Current record and Restore writes only the current record, as FileMaker Pro 26 does with the dialog off. Without groups, Export Records and Save Records as Excel write each record's own running total and fraction of total, matching FileMaker Pro 26's tab-separated and whole-found-set Excel output for a running total without restart and a fraction without subtotal. In a grouped export, the desktop and OpenMaker Server both write the found set's grand summary on the first row, as FileMaker Pro 26 does locally for a running total and a fraction of total.
features.remaining: Grouping editor, saved settings and further format/layout options remain. Restarting, subtotaled and other summary options, break-field rows of grouped exports, grouped Excel and other formats, the current-record Excel row and FileMaker Server's values are unmeasured (issue 372). Save Records as Excel with its dialog on is not compared with FileMaker Pro.
